title: Slow start: power not linked
moves: First block with un-zoned power columns
happened: Built the full first block on day one, but only one of the four power columns touched the coal plant, so most zones had no power for a year (120 people by January). Linked the columns in February.
watching: Growth now that every zone has power.

title: 1,000 people

watching: Water: only 44% of buildings have water yet.
